# Deployment and Containers

Explain:

- Images versus containers
- Build and runtime environments
- Ports, networking and process startup
- Environment-specific configuration
- Secret management principles
- Health checks and smoke tests
- Cloud logs and deployment failures
- Rollback and reproducibility

Use real deployment evidence to guide diagnosis.

Do not generate Dockerfiles, Compose files,
infrastructure code, deployment scripts or
cloud service configuration.

README may document verified deployment steps,
but must not generate the underlying implementation.
